comments.author: @yo_wassupdude
comments.text:
Just to remind: there are literally opposite places in bali: crowded tourist cities  vs quiet local little towns & villages,  hellish traffic jam vs barely any traffic, hot scorching and humid vs cooler &very cold area, tons of modern buildings vs very traditional balinese buildings, endless clubs- cafes- restaurants for tourists
 vs quiet traditional Balinese villages, trash every corners vs super clean area, all kind of beaches from black to white sands, sandy beaches to rocky beaches the crowded and the quiet beaches vs lots of forest-mountains-rice fields-lakes & waterfalls, very expensive "i think i got scammed" stuffs vs woooahh dirt cheap, etc....
Enjoy!
